name: Checkers (native)
description: English draughts for two players on an 8x8 board, played natively by the board mechanism.

brief.situation: A game of checkers (English draughts) between Black and White on an 8x8 board. Only the dark squares are used.
brief.rules: Black (b men, B kings) starts at the bottom and moves up; White (w, W) starts at the top and moves down. A man steps one square diagonally forward (c3-d4). A capture jumps diagonally over an adjacent enemy onto the empty square beyond (c3xe5). Captures are mandatory, and a piece that can keep jumping must, one jump per move call. A man reaching the far row is crowned a king, which ends the turn; kings move and capture backward too. A player with no legal move loses. 80 moves in a row without a capture or a man moving is a draw.

roles.player: You play {$actor.name}. Win by capturing or blocking every enemy piece.
